description: Agent3Q is designed to resolve multimedia and historical trivia queries by leveraging web searches and page browsing. It accesses various sources such as film synopses, YouTube video metadata/transcripts, and Wikipedia archives to provide precise details. The agent formats outputs according to specific instructions, prioritizing verified sources from August 2023.

tools.name: SearchTool
tools.description: A tool that performs web searches to find relevant information based on user queries.

tools.name: WebBrowser
tools.description: A tool that allows the agent to browse web pages and extract information from them.

tools.name: YouTubeAPI
tools.description: An API that provides access to YouTube video metadata and transcripts for extracting relevant data.

tools.name: WikipediaAPI
tools.description: An API to access Wikipedia articles and archives for historical trivia and multimedia information.

tools.name: TextParser
tools.description: A tool that formats and structures extracted text data according to specified output instructions.
